title: 茶水间英文 - 11月13日 | 微软大宕机、英伟达接班难题、凯恩破纪录
description:
Microsoft 365 went down around the world on Thursday, locking millions out of Outlook and Teams, while Nvidia picked up the pieces after its founder's resignation with no succession plan in sight. And in happier news, England beat Croatia two-one at Wembley on Thursday night, with Harry Kane scoring the winner on his record-breaking 126th appearance for England. Plus a random question: if your phone could talk, what would it say to you first thing in the morning?

微软 365 周四全球大宕机，Outlook 和 Teams 集体罢工，无数打工人一早发现邮箱打不开；英伟达则在创始人辞职后手忙脚乱接班，三十三年里居然从没准备过接班计划。好消息也有：英格兰周四晚在温布利二比一击败克罗地亚，凯恩在他破纪录的第 126 次出场里罚进致胜点球。今天还有一个随机问题：如果你的手机会说话，一大早它会对你说什么？

Words to steal 生词本：
- go down — 宕机；出故障
- bounce back — 反弹；恢复
- roll back — 回滚；撤销（变更）
- succession plan — 接班计划
- interim — 临时的；代理的
- closed-door — 闭门的；不公开的
- record-breaker — 破纪录者；创纪录的人
- catch up — 赶上进度；补上
